messages:
dario: Heads-up: were opening a small dedicated capacity wave in EU-CENTRAL for h200v2 (40GB, fp16-focused). Target start: Thu Sep 2 01:00 UTC.
dario: Pools: `h200v2-eu-central-primary` and `h200v2-eu-central-burst`. Initial nodes: 20/zone (3 AZs), with +10 burst.
emily: Sequencing will be 1a -> 1b -> 1c, stagger ~8h to validate metrics between waves. Partner preview for two customers night before.
vikram: New policy note: during the preview period were temporarily relaxing minimum reservation terms to 7 days for early adopters. Post-preview terms revert to standard monthly min.
ops-bot: NOTE: rolling infra updates only; no tenant VM reboots expected. Increased trace sampling for first 48h enabled.
emily: Routing behavior: new allocations will prefer h200v2 where project quota allows. Hard SKU pins remain on their pools unless customer requests migration. No auto-migration.
finance-bot: Billing: h200v2-dedicated will use a preview rate. If customers migrate during preview and final price is lower, well issue prorated credits. Final pricing after 10-day bake.
support-bot: Support playbook ready. Tag infra tickets `h200v2-rollout`. Escalation: @support -> @vikram -> platform on-call. Canned customer responses drafted.
vikram: Telemetry to watch: token P50/P95, kernel OOM events, and KV-cache hit-rate. Well enable a 10% trace sampler and an early-OOM alert for 72h.
emily: Important: h200v2 is optimized for inference. Please block training workloads on these pools during rollout via quota rules.
dario: Partner preview: Wed Sep 1 21:00-23:00 UTC in eu-central-1a. If green, bulk rollout begins Sep 2 01:00 UTC.
emily: I'll publish the internal migration snippets and console one-click migrate flag after preview.
dario: Final: Ill post an external customer note once 1a is live. Ping me for a whitelist if you need early access.
